example_summary: Mr. Abhishek mortgaged his residential house under a notified reverse mortgage scheme and received monthly loan installments.
source_provision:
### Reverse Mortgage Scheme: Statutory Framework

| Transaction Phase | Statutory Section | Taxability / Legal Effect | Statutory Benefit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mortgaging of Asset** | **Section 47(xvi)** | Excluded from definition of 'Transfer' | **Nil** Capital Gains Tax |
| **Receipt of Loan (Lump sum / Installments)** | **Section 10(43)** | Excluded from Total Income | **100% Tax Exempt** Loan Receipts |
| **Alienation / Sale by Bank for Recovery** | **Section 45** | Chargeable to Capital Gains Tax | Taxed in the year of transfer |


**Key Statutory Conditions**

* **Eligible Scheme:** The reverse mortgage must be under a scheme made and notified by the Central Government.

* **Nature of Receipts:** Loan disbursed either as lump sum or monthly/periodic installments is non-taxable u/s 10(43).


> [!WARNING] Recovery vs Mortgage: While the initial mortgage to the bank is not a transfer, any subsequent sale or transfer of the property by the bank to recover unpaid dues triggers Capital Gains tax u/s 45.

director.justification: The transaction spans three distinct phases where general taxability rules on property transfer and income are overridden by specific non-transfer and exemption provisions until final bank alienation.
director.visual_metaphor: A three-stage security vault where property stays protected under statutory shields during mortgage and loan disbursements, until bank recovery unlocks capital gains liability.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Introduce Mr. Abhishek, a senior citizen mortgaging his residential house under a notified reverse mortgage scheme.
Explain Section 47(xvi) which excludes the creation of reverse mortgage from the definition of transfer.
Highlight Section 10(43) exempting loan receipts received as monthly installments or lump sum from income tax.
Detail the default recovery mechanism where bank alienation of the mortgaged property triggers capital gains u/s 45.
Summarize the tax treatment across mortgage creation, loan receipt, and final bank recovery stage.

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 47(xvi) ഉം Section 10(43) ഉം ആണ് പ്രധാന statutory provisions. Section 47(xvi) പ്രകാരം, ഒരു Capital Asset, notified Reverse Mortgage Scheme കീഴിൽ mortgage ചെയ്യുന്നത് 'transfer' ആയി കണക്കാക്കില്ല. അതുകൊണ്ട് mortgage ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ Capital Gains tax നൽകേണ്ടതില്ല.

visual_data.rule: Any transfer of a capital asset in a transaction of reverse mortgage under a scheme made and notified by the Central Government shall not be considered as a transfer for the purpose of capital gain.
visual_data.application: Mortgaging of residential house with bank by Mr. Abhishek will not be regarded as a transfer, resulting in Nil Capital Gains.
